verdict.rationale: The evidence pack holds substantive verbatim text pulled from many public gov.uk guidance pages: the Skilled Worker, Innovator Founder and Global Talent visa pages, visa processing times, and the browse and organisation pages. That strongly implies the public reading surface is server-rendered and retrievable without a key, login, bot wall or JS-only shell. No evidence states the access policy directly or records the user agent used. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that retrieval used a standard identified agent user agent, documented absence of CAPTCHA or bot-protection policies, independent hands-on corroboration of agent access.
